answer_1.quote: We evaluate a range of approaches to moderation, including existing prosocial dialogue models and prompted ITLMs ...

answer_2.quote: We instead rely on directly asking questions as a survey about these dimensions to human participants ...

answer_3.quote: We also test whether annotations from GPT-4 can be a reliable proxy of human annotations ... We ask the same questions to GPT-4 and GPT-3.5

answer_4.guideline: Participants answer four Likert‑scale questions about cooperative, respectful, specific, and fair aspects of the moderator.
